messages:
maria: Quick sync 3: I'm assembling the release notes for Monday's docs push. Need: concise whats-new bullets, SDK snippet refresh, and a short known-issues section. Who can take which?

tiffany: I can write the three whats-new bullets. Keep them single-line headlines + 1 sentence each.

sam: I'll handle SDK snippets. Need to convert the old `create_completion` examples to `responses.create()` and add a streaming example.

jordan: I'll collect known issues and add repros. Currently we have: embeddings drift for long inputs, and occasional model fallback timeouts in eu-west.

maria: Good. Sam, prefer examples that mirror the new JS and Python SDK shapes. Use `client.responses.stream()` for streaming demo.

sam: Draft snippet (python): ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model="kestrel-3", prompt="Write a haiku about servers"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

tiffany: Draft bullets posted to PR #812: 1) Streaming responses — stable and GA; 2) Embed quality profile updates; 3) SDK migration guide for v1.

nate: I ran the link-checker on the branch. Found 4 stale internal links (old SDK path + one dead anchor). Report: /tmp/linkcheck-812.txt.

jordan: I'll patch the anchor and update the redirect for SDK path. For embeddings drift, adding workaround: pin quantization to `q4_0` or truncate at 1024 tokens.

maria: Add a short "how to migrate" note under the migration bullet: `create_completion` -> `responses.create()`, `on_token` callbacks are deprecated. Also add console note: "Streaming is opt-in per-route."

sam: Updated snippets and added a tiny migration section in markdown with CLI example to bulk-replace old links: `grep -R "docs.redwood.ai/sdk" -l | xargs sed -i 's|docs.redwood.ai/sdk|docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v1|g'`

docs-bot: Preview build ready for branch `relnotes/2026-03-22-snippets` (build 514): https://docs-preview.internal.redwood.ai/relnotes-2112223333 :white_check_mark:

tiffany: Quick tone pass request: can we make bullets more customer-focused, e.g., say "lower latency for streaming" instead of just "streaming responses"?

maria: Yes, make them benefit-first. Also add marketing co-sign line at the bottom of the release note.

nate: After fixes, link-check passes locally. I'll push the redirect PR.

sam: Merging snippets after preview check. Will tag the SDK repo for a parallel example update.

jordan: Patching known-issues doc now. Will include repro gist and a Dockerfile for the embeddings case.

maria: Target: merge by 11pm PT so publishing automation can pick it up for Monday. If anything blocks, ping me directly. Thanks all. :tada:
